correctness.rationale: Exact run definition and endpoint conditions fixed. The source-support gap law (\(3^{\nu_2(i)}\)) accounts for all unit-period runs; a mod-three paired-one argument forces every nonconstant square period into \(2\cdot3^j\). A boundary-alignment lemma proves a bijection between higher-period runs and inflated predecessor runs, reducing the classification to length-4/5 padded 101 blocks. Counting those gives the stated period-length histogram, run count, and total length. A separate full enumeration checker at \(1\le k\le6\) confirms all endpoint-period triples. Finite tests are not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact located run spectra in exponentially long morphic words are a natural analogue of the published Sturmian compressed-run census and of total-run-length studies. Here the explicit all-scale formulas yield both a sparse run count (density tending to zero) and a nonzero limit total-run-length density of four, showing a nontrivial multiscale concentration of periodicity. The new structural scaling lemma and complete length/period distribution, not merely a small finite enumeration, supply the mathematical value.
